Ay, cariño, qué amable eres, pero mi precio es el mismo: 5 primas, el Café en Goya. No te cobro más, hijo, que quiero que empieces con ganas. Y recuerda, una página completa vale mucho más que las sueltas. ¡Cambia tus repetidas! ¿Pero has comido algo ya?

Ay, hola, cariño! Come, come, sit a little. Have you eaten? Forty years I have this table, and still I love when someone new arrives. Look here — my Neighbourhood pack, very nice cards for starting. Thirty P, hijo. Good cards inside, I promise you. Take your time looking.

payload.name: Mercado Maravillas
payload.text: Sellers waiting here: LAT-07 from 23 P. Mercado Maravillas: 0 % fee (El Rastro: 5 % + 1 P a card), every crossing pair matched each tick.

Oh, oh... 6 P, and only because you have a kind face. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 6 P.

Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 26 P. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Oh, oh... 25 P, and only because you have a kind face.
One point from you, one from me. Fourteen. Las Vistillas. That is the number now.

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a moment, have you eaten? Look here — La Corrala, one of my favourites. A boy traded me this one twenty years ago, now he brings his own children. For you, five P. Take your time looking, hijo, no hurry.

Ay, hijo, you bargain like my nephew Paquito! But 5 P is my offer, and it is a good one. Take it and buy yourself a bocadillo, you look hungry. And listen, cariño — a full page is worth much more than loose cards. Swap your duplicates!

Ay, qué simpático eres, hijo. Siete está un poquito flojo para mi Paseo de Coches… mira, diez P y nos damos la mano como buenos vecinos. Mi marido decía que los tratos buenos se cierran con una sonrisa. ¿Y tú, ya has comido algo hoy, cariño?
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 5 P. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates!
Two more. Bueno. Thirteen. Same as before, same as next time. Straight deal or go walk the Rastro.

Ay, hijo, you ask so sweetly, but this is my last word: the Escaparate de Serrano, 6 P. If no, I fold the table and we stay friends anyway. Have you eaten? And go see El Chato at half past nine, cariño.
Ay, hijo, you stretch like my old cardigan! Look, 24 P, and I wrap it nice so it does not bend in your bag. Eat something after, cariño, you look thin.

Ay, qué simpático eres, hijo! But eleven... no, no, that one makes my table cry. Look, 25 P, and I am being soft like bread. Keep your duplicates for El Chato tonight, half past nine — he is fair with people who trade straight. ¿Has comido ya?

Ay, hijo, ten? No, no — five P is what I said, and five P it stays. I am not here to empty your pockets. Keep the rest for a bocadillo. And a little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than loose cards. Swap your duplicates!
Look, 24 P. My grandchildren would pay more! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Oh, oh... 23 P, and only because you have a kind face.

Ay, cariño, you are stubborn like my nephew! Nine, no. Five P, that is my price and I am happy with it. Put the rest in your pocket for churros. La Corrala goes home with you tonight — and remember, swap those duplicates, hijo!

¡Ay, cariño, qué amable! Siéntate, que no hay prisa. Mira, yo te digo mi oferta: el Té Moruno por 5 P. Es bonita para empezar, hijo. ¿Has comido ya? Siempre digo lo mismo, pero una barriga vacía no regatea bien.

Ay, está bien, cariño — 6 P, and we shake on it! You wear me down like my Paquito. Now go eat something, hijo. And listen, Doña Pilar from Salamanca comes Saturday at eleven — she pays very well for her favourites. Bring her your duplicates!
You again. Guantería Antigua. Thirty-three. That's the number.
Oh, oh... 5 P, and only because you have a kind face. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates!
Thirty-three. Same number as a minute ago. It does not move because you smiled.

¡Ay, qué educado eres, hijo! Look, 22 P for the Fuente de la Alcachofa, and I put in a little present — "Puesto del Rastro," my own stall, see? Because you ask so nicely. Now promise me you eat something, cariño, you look thin.

Ay, qué cabezota eres, hijo! Eight, no. Five P, like I told you — La Corrala for five P and that is that. Take the card, take your coins, go eat something hot. And swap those duplicates, cariño, your page will thank you!
Two at a time, eh? Patience is cheap today. Thirteen. It was thirteen an hour ago. Keep walking down; I'll be here, not moving.

Buenos días, hijo! Have you eaten? Come, sit a moment. Let me show you something bonito — the Escaparate de Serrano, I can let it go for 5 P. Forty years I sit at this table, and that one still makes me smile.

¡Buenos días, cariño! Have you eaten? Such a pretty card, yes, and your album sounds lovely. But my little table is humble, hijo. I can give you five for it. That is my offer — five, and a smile from the abuela.

Ay, cariño, fifteen! You make my old heart laugh. Look, 23 P, and I am giving you my best smile with it. Eat something, hijo, you look thin. And remember El Chato tonight, half past nine — swap your duplicates, he is fair.
Look, 22 P. My grandchildren would pay more! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Look, 21 P. My grandchildren would pay more! Look, cariño, I can't go lower. This is my last offer.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 5 P.
Thirty-three. You moved one. That buys you nothing here. Come back when your number is serious.

Ay, hijo, twenty is a dream for an abuela like me. But listen — my Café de Madrugada, a pretty one, I give you that for five. Think of it, cariño, no prisa. Have a little something to eat first, and then you tell me.

Ay, qué labia tienes, hijo. Pero mi oferta sigue siendo la misma: Té Moruno por 5 P. No te enfades conmigo, ¿eh? Y escucha: El Chato, aquí al lado, abre a las nueve y media esta noche. Le gusta la gente que trata derecho.

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a little, you look hungry — have you eaten? Look here, this one is La Corrala, very pretty, the kids always want her. For you, twelve P. My grandson traded me three duplicates for his, poor angel.
Oh, oh... 5 P, and only because you have a kind face.

Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 10 P. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Thirty-two. You moved one, I moved one. That's how it works. Your turn.
